events.title: Tiny Fortress Release Date!
events.summary: Hello Tiny Fortress fans,I am happy to announce that Tiny Fortress officially has a release date:December 10, 2026(Less than two months away!)Mark your calendars, the incremental TD experience of a lifetime is finally at your doorstep =)From the devs,RKO & David Elliot

events.title: Demo Changes
events.summary: Hello all,We updated our demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, including performance improvements, visual FX changes, and more.However, due to the nature of these changes the demo is different enough from before that your save file will not carry over. We apologize for the inconvenience. New players will be completely unaffected by these changes and should have a seamless experience.Thank you for understanding,Dave

events.title: Renamed to TINY FORTRESS
events.summary: Hello beloved players,Our game is now titled "Tiny Fortress".As a side note, you may have to uninstall, then re-install the Tiny Fortress demo in order to play it again.We recently were made aware of a trademark made by a mobile game company on a title that was very similar to ours. Because of this news, we have decided to change the title of our game to Tiny Fortress.Thank you for understanding, and our apologies for any inconvenience.Sincerely,RKO & David Elliot
